svg.title: Saturation and windup on the water heater
svg.desc: The request exceeds 100 percent from 1 second while the stored integral keeps rising to 113.2 percent. After the setpoint returns to 35 degrees Celsius at 10 seconds the heater stays at full power until 12.0 seconds, the water peaks at 39.57 degrees and is back within 0.2 degrees only from 44.8 seconds.
svg.text: Saturation and windup on the water heater
Simulator run of this project · setpoint 45 °C, back to 35 °C at 10 s · numbers answer the predictions
